briefings.tldr: While AI is currently driving a technology-led U.S. growth boom (accounting for 1.5 percentage points of the 2.1% real GDP growth), its transformative productivity "magic" has not yet materialized in aggregate data, and overlapping supply shocks—including AI-related price surges—have kept inflation above target for nearly six years, requiring further monetary policy tightening.
